instruction.text: Alex is building a straight path that is 𝘯 tiles long. Each square tile has a width of 30 cm. Write a formula for L, the total length of the path, in terms of 𝘯.

atoms.instruction: Use your formula to calculate the total length of the path if there are 9 tiles.
Use your formula to calculate the total length of the path if there are 16 tiles.

instruction.text: A rectangle has a length of 𝘭 cm and a width of 𝘸 cm. Write a simplified formula for P, the perimeter of the rectangle, in terms of 𝘭 and 𝘸.
instruction.sound: A rectangle has a length of l centimetres and a width of w centimetres. Write a simplified formula for P, the perimeter of the rectangle, in terms of l and w.

atoms.instruction: Use your formula to calculate the perimeter of a rectangle with a length of 8 cm and a width of 5 cm.
Use your formula to calculate the perimeter of a rectangle with a length of 5 cm and a width of 19 cm.

instruction.text: A graph shows the cost of a taxi journey based on the distance travelled in kilometres. Answer the questions.

atoms.a: What is the fixed starting fee?
atoms.hint: Look at the total cost after 0 kilometres.

atoms.a: How much does each kilometre cost?
atoms.hint: Look at how much the cost increases when the distance travelled increases by 1 kilometre.

atoms.a: Write a formula for the total cost, C, in terms of 𝘥, distance travelled.

atoms.instruction: Use your formula to calculate the cost of a 7-kilometre journey.
Use your formula to calculate the cost of a 21-kilometre journey.

instruction.text: This graph shows the total volume of water in a tank over time. When a tap connected to the tank is turned on, water flows out at a constant rate. Answer the questions.

atoms.a: What is the initial volume of water in the tank?
atoms.hint: Look at the volume of water at 0 minutes.

atoms.a: How many litres of water flow out of the tank each minute?
atoms.hint: Look at how much the volume decreases when the time increases by 1 minute.

atoms.a: Write a formula for V, the total volume of water, in terms of 𝘵, time after the tap is turned on.

atoms.instruction: Use your formula to calculate the volume of water after 7 minutes.
Use your formula to calculate the volume of water after 15 minutes.
